claims: Mission-level lifecycle orchestration enforces strict 19-state progress gates from discovery to release review, preventing premature execution.

evidence: AWS Step Functions and Netflix Conductor use independent supervisor subroutines to evaluate execution outcomes.

limitations: Synthetic mission simulations use synthetic mock adapters until commercial API execution is authorized.
recommendation: Implement Autonomous Engineering Mission Engine, 19-state lifecycle, Agent Council, Meta-Governance Engine, and synthetic mission fixtures in EOS Control Plane.
